decision: On 2026-11-23 Peter approved publishing v0.6.7 for the root, backend/cuda and backend/vulkan, with source-tip CI, fresh canonical module pins and asset checksum checks required. The previous-tag cold-user qualification, full CUDA and Metal device suites, broad parity sweep and Linux and Darwin quick -full runs are deferred. The selected backend pins are verified before tagging using Go's staged canonical root archive. Public standalone tag builds and fresh Go proxy and checksum database consumer builds follow publication. Metal retains its existing pin.
